production_source_comparison.interpretation: All runtime/build paths match the same successful cloud commit. Eight existing local user extensions are retained separately.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.
Queries are restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0. LN2 decodes only 0/1; the performance word is opaque and does not provide physical core mapping or power units.

Per-core/CCD storage boundaries are verified against MP5 copy instructions. Field labels, units, active masks, physical mapping, and dual-rail voltage consumption/readback remain unverified; runtime 61h stays denied.
AMD PStates writes, other AMD platforms and Curve Shaper, remaining Intel server/board controls, dynamic memory/EC and broader native PM transport remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

observations: Core and CCD stored arrays expose slot labels, unverified units, raw binary32 words and correct 634h / 2a34h starts at maximum width.
Table and bottom status are visible, without overlaps; long tables scroll.
Manual OC enable displays capability 00000007 to 00010007 and matching mode bit readback.
